mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 86 degrees at Verona Community Park under partly cloudy skies. Tonight the moon is a Waning Gibbous, and you can catch the space station passing from the Northwest over Verona High School towards the East Northeast at 4:17 AM. Overnight, the temperature will drop to 71 degrees with no rain expected.

The Verona Senior Center is updating their flooring starting September 1, which will cause limited access and closures through September 11, and crews are currently working to repair a water main break near Todd Street.
Yoga at Insight Wellness is available today, followed by a busy Tuesday schedule featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown farmer's market.
On August 27, a traffic stop led to the arrest of a 56-year-old passenger who had several outstanding arrest warrants while the driver was cited for registration issues.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Dove, and you have until 10:00 PM tonight to head over to the store and enjoy it.
